objective: Event dispatcher remediation: backoff, concurrency, cursor recovery, metrics and DLQ ownership
acceptance_criteria: DispatchOnce has fail-able tests for matching, dedupe, retry with backoff/status gating, DLQ after max attempts, cursor recovery and concurrent passes.
Dispatcher applies filter semantics, isolates per-event failures, emits metrics/logs, and rejects cross-tenant subscription collisions instead of silently succeeding.
Event delivery/DLQ ownership is explicitly recorded (reuse or ADR amendment), store registry evidence is present, and migration rollback requires a verified backup.
